newsitem.title: UK: T&N says US court to review Georgine upset.
newsitem.headline: T&N says US court to review Georgine upset.

text.p: British-based automotive components group T&N Plc said on Monday that the United States Supreme Court has agreed to review a previous lower court decision to decertify, or overturn, the so-called Georgine asbestos injury claims settlement system.

The Georgine settlement, as it is known, provides a relatively predictable and financially stable mechanism for processing asbestos-related claims and T&N has said that decertification of the system would increase its costs.
"A decision by the Supreme Court is not expected for some considerable time," T&N said in a statement.

"The Georgine settlement procedures will continue to operate until that decision is reached. As a result, T&N expects that asbestos charges will continue to be incurred in line with those previously anticipated of around 25 million stg in the second half of 1996," the company added.

The group also made a trading statement in which it noted that market uncertainties and an unclear trading outlook as the year ends meant it was "particularly difficult to assess the final outcome of the year's results".
It warned short-term operating margins on some product lines had fallen.
